short: Cut taxes, tripled the debt, and signed the first treaty to abolish a class of weapons.
full:
Reagan was shot in the chest outside a Washington hotel on 30 March 1981, ten weeks into his term, and recovered quickly. His Economic Recovery Tax Act cut the top rate of income tax from 70 to 50 per cent, later to 28, while Paul Volcker's Federal Reserve broke inflation with a recession that pushed unemployment near 11 per cent. Defence spending rose sharply and the national debt roughly tripled.

He denounced the Soviet Union as an evil empire, then found a counterpart in Mikhail Gorbachev and signed the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty in December 1987, the first agreement to eliminate an entire class of nuclear weapons. The Iran-Contra affair, in which arms were sold to Iran and the proceeds diverted to Nicaraguan rebels against an explicit congressional ban, produced fourteen indictments and consumed much of his second term.
